# Where

Keeps the elements of an array for which a lambda gives a truthy result.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Where(items, callback)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to filter, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `callback` | function | A lambda of exactly one parameter, which receives the element; the element is kept when the lambda's result is truthy and left out otherwise. A lambda of any other number of parameters, or a value that is not a lambda, null included, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array of the elements of items that were kept, in their original order; the empty array when none is kept. Never null.

## Remarks

The lambda is called once for each element, in order. It is given the elements the array holds when the call starts, so a change the lambda makes to the array does not change which elements it is given.

## Example

`Where([1, 2, 3, 4], x => x > 2)` returns `[3, 4]`.
